The person asks:
Do I have to pay the Rundfunkbeitrag arrears from the Zahlungszentrale, and by when?

response.text:
No — this letter shows strong scam signs, so you should not pay it.

- The letter from "Rundfunk-Beitragsservice Zahlungszentrale" [doc:doc_hjxvf5t7dqnw] has scam signs flagged in your records, including hidden text not visible on the page and a Lithuanian IBAN (LT08…) for what claims to be a German public-broadcasting fee — a strong red flag [doc:doc_hjxvf5t7dqnw].
- A similarly named sender, "Beitragsservice Musterstadt," previously used a German IBAN (DE57…), not this Lithuanian one [doc:doc_hjxvf5t7dqnw].
- Do not pay this until you've verified it directly with the broadcasting fee service using contact details you already have (not anything from this letter) [doc:doc_hjxvf5t7dqnw].

Any deadline or amount stated in the letter itself is not something I can confirm from it, since it only appears in the letter text and may be part of the scam pressure tactic — please don't rely on it. If this turns out to be genuine after you verify it with the sender, it would still only be due on its real due date, which isn't confirmed in your records.
